qualification: 250条具体作者值/来源绑定均实际审阅，长表和描述复用此前完整字面阅读；非解析器替代实读。resolved_author_values保留作者语法（串/有序重复），不是运行对象或编译后整图；两个Evolution拼写属于一个逻辑列表。终检类型、前驱、查找回退由consumer-reception处理。

resolved_author_values.Name: Venusaur
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: In order to support its flower, which has grown larger due to Mega Evolution, its back and legs have become stronger.

resolved_author_values.Name: Charizard
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The overwhelming power that fills its entire body causes it to turn black and create intense blue flames.

resolved_author_values.Name: Charizard
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its bond with its Trainer is the source of its power. It boasts speed and maneuverability greater than that of a jet fighter.

resolved_author_values.Name: Blastoise
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The cannon on its back is as powerful as a tank gun. Its tough legs and back enable it to withstand the recoil from firing the cannon.

resolved_author_values.Name: Beedrill
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its legs have become poison stingers. It stabs its prey repeatedly with the stingers on its limbs, dealing the final blow with the stinger on its rear.

resolved_author_values.Name: Pidgeot
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: With its muscular strength now greatly increased, it can fly continuously for two weeks without resting.

resolved_author_values.Name: Rattata
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: With its incisors, it gnaws through doors and infiltrates people's homes. Then, with a twitch of its whiskers, it steals whatever food it finds.

resolved_author_values.Name: Raticate
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It forms a group of Rattata, which it assumes command of. Each group has its own territory, and disputes over food happen often.

resolved_author_values.Name: Raichu
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It uses psychokinesis to control electricity. It hops aboard its own tail, using psychic power to lift the tail and move about while riding it.

resolved_author_values.Name: Sandshrew
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The skin on its back is as hard as steel. Predators go after its soft belly, so it clings to the ground desperately.

resolved_author_values.Name: Sandslash
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It runs across snow-covered plains at high speeds. It developed thick, sharp claws to plow through the snow.

resolved_author_values.Name: Vulpix
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: In hot weather, this Pokémon makes ice shards with its six tails and sprays them around to cool itself off.

resolved_author_values.Name: Ninetales
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It lives on mountains perpetually covered in snow and is revered as a deity incarnate. It appears draped in a blizzard.

resolved_author_values.Name: Diglett
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its head sports an altered form of whiskers made of metal. When in communication with its comrades, its whiskers wobble to and fro.

resolved_author_values.Name: Dugtrio
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its shining gold hair provides it with protection. It's reputed that keeping any of its fallen hairs will bring bad luck.

resolved_author_values.Name: Meowth
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It's impulsive, selfish, and fickle. It's very popular with some Trainers who like giving it the attention it needs.

resolved_author_values.Name: Persian
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its round face is a symbol of wealth. Persian that have bigger, plumper faces are considered more beautiful.

resolved_author_values.Name: Alakazam
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Having traded away its muscles, Alakazam's true power has been unleashed. With its psychic powers, it can foresee all things.

resolved_author_values.Name: Geodude
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Geodude compete against each other with headbutts. The iron sand on their heads will stick to whichever one has stronger magnetism.

resolved_author_values.Name: Graveler
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: They eat rocks and often get into a scrap over them. The shock of Graveler smashing together causes a flash of light and a booming noise.

resolved_author_values.Name: Golem
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It fires rocks charged with electricity. Even if the rock isn't fired that accurately, just grazing an opponent will cause numbness and fainting.

resolved_author_values.Name: Slowbro
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Having been swallowed whole by Shellder, Slowbro now has an iron defense. It's pretty comfortable in there, too.

resolved_author_values.Name: Grimer
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: A Grimer, which had been brought in to solve a problem with garbage, developed over time into this form.

resolved_author_values.Name: Muk
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The garbage it eats causes continuous chemical changes in its body, which produce its exceedingly vivid coloration.

resolved_author_values.Name: Gengar
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The energy of Mega Evolution awakened it. It sinks into another dimension, where it keeps a patient watch for its chance to attack.

resolved_author_values.Name: Exeggutor
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: As it grew taller and taller, it outgrew its reliance on psychic powers, while within it awakened the power of the sleeping dragon.

resolved_author_values.Name: Cubone
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It pines for the mother it will never see again. Seeing a likeness of its mother in the full moon, it cries. The stains on the skull it wears are from its tears.

resolved_author_values.Name: Marowak
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its custom is to mourn its lost companions. Mounds of dirt by the side of the road mark the graves of the Marowak.

resolved_author_values.Name: Kangaskhan
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The explosive energy the child is bathed in causes temporary growth. The mother is beside herself with worry about it.

resolved_author_values.Name: Pinsir
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It zips around at blistering speeds, looking for an opening to skewer its opponent on its giant pincers.

resolved_author_values.Name: Gyarados
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It zooms out of the water at Mach speeds. Even large ships caught in its path are split cleanly in two!

resolved_author_values.Name: Aerodactyl
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: When it Mega Evolves, it becomes more vicious than ever before. Some say that's because its excess of power is causing it pain.

resolved_author_values.Name: Mewtwo
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Psychic power has augmented its muscles. It has a grip strength of one ton and can sprint a hundred meters in two seconds flat!

resolved_author_values.Name: Mewtwo
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Despite its diminished size, its mental power has grown phenomenally. With a mere thought, it can smash a skyscraper to smithereens.

resolved_author_values.Name: Pichu
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It is still inept at retaining electricity. When it is startled, it discharges power accidentally. It gets better at holding power as it grows older.

resolved_author_values.Name: Ampharos
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Massive amounts of energy intensely stimulated Ampharos's cells, apparently awakening its long-sleeping dragon's blood.

resolved_author_values.Name: Unown
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient text characters. Although research is ongoing, it is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown.

resolved_author_values.Name: Steelix
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Steelix live even further underground than Onix. This Pokémon is known to dig toward the earth's core, reaching a depth of over six-tenths of a mile underground.

resolved_author_values.Name: Scizor
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It's better at beating things than grasping them. When it battles for a long time, the weight of its pincers becomes too much to bear.

resolved_author_values.Name: Heracross
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: A tremendous influx of energy builds it up, but when Mega Evolution ends, Heracross is bothered by terrible soreness in its muscles.

resolved_author_values.Name: Houndoom
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its red claws and the tips of its tail are melting from high internal temperatures that are painful to Houndoom itself.

resolved_author_values.Name: Tyranitar
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Due to the colossal power poured into it, this Pokémon's back split right open. Its destructive instincts are the only thing keeping it moving.

resolved_author_values.Name: Sceptile
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: In the jungle, its power is without equal. This Pokémon carefully grows trees and plants. It regulates its body temperature by basking in sunlight.

resolved_author_values.Name: Blaziken
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It learns martial arts that use punches and kicks. Every several years, its old feathers burn off, and new, supple feathers grow back in their place.

resolved_author_values.Name: Swampert
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: If it senses the approach of a storm and a tidal wave, it protects its seaside nest by piling up boulders. It swims as fast as a jet ski.

resolved_author_values.Name: Gardevoir
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It apparently does not feel the pull of gravity because it supports itself with psychic power. It will give its life to protect its trainer.

resolved_author_values.Name: Sableye
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Supporting a giant heavy jewel, it can't change direction very nimbly and is vulnerable to attack from behind.

resolved_author_values.Name: Mawile
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its two sets of jaws thrash about violently as if they each had a will of their own. One gnash from them can turn a boulder to dust.

resolved_author_values.Name: Aggron
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its iron horns grow longer a little at a time. They are used to determine the Aggron's age. The gouges in its armor are worn with pride as mementos from battles.

resolved_author_values.Name: Medicham
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Through crushingly harsh yoga training, it gained the power to foretell its foe's actions. It battles with elegant, dance- like movement.

resolved_author_values.Name: Manectric
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Too much electricity has built up in its body, irritating Manectric. Its explosive speed is equal to that of a lightning bolt.

resolved_author_values.Name: Sharpedo
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The yellow patterns it bears are old scars. The energy from Mega Evolution runs through them, causing it sharp pain and suffering.

resolved_author_values.Name: Camerupt
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: A Pokémon that lives in the crater of a volcano. Every 10 years, the volcanoes on its back erupt violently. Research is under way on the cause of eruption.

resolved_author_values.Name: Altaria
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It hums in a beautiful soprano voice. It flies among white clouds in the blue sky. It launches intensely hot fireballs from its mouth.

resolved_author_values.Name: Castform
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes on the brightest of days. Its skin is unexpectedly hot to the touch, so approach with care.

resolved_author_values.Name: Castform
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when soaked with rain. When its body is compressed, water will seep out as if from a sponge.

resolved_author_values.Name: Castform
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This is the form Castform takes when covered in snow. Its body becomes an ice-like material, with a temperature near -5 degrees Celsius.

resolved_author_values.Name: Banette
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Extraordinary energy amplifies its cursing power to such an extent that it can't help but curse its own Trainer.

resolved_author_values.Name: Absol
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: When this Pokémon whips the winglike fur on its back as though beating its wings, it sends an intimidating aura flying at its opponents.

resolved_author_values.Name: Glalie
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It envelops prey in its mouth, freezing them instantly. But its jaw is dislocated, so it's unable to eat them.

resolved_author_values.Name: Salamence
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It puts its forelegs inside its shell to streamline itself for flight. Salamence flies at high speeds over all kinds of topographical features.

resolved_author_values.Name: Metagross
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its intellect surpasses its previous level, resulting in battles so cruel, they'll make you want to cover your eyes.

resolved_author_values.Name: Latias
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: They make a small herd of only several members. They rarely make contact with people or other Pokémon. They disappear if they sense enemies.

resolved_author_values.Name: Latios
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Even in hiding, it can detect the locations of others and sense their emotions since it has telepathy. Its intelligence allows it to understand human languages.

resolved_author_values.Name: Kyogre
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Kyogre has appeared in mythology as the creator of the sea. After long years of feuding with Groudon, it took to sleep at the bottom of the sea.

resolved_author_values.Name: Groudon
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Groudon has appeared in mythology as the creator of the land. It sleeps in magma underground and is said to make volcanoes erupt on awakening.

resolved_author_values.Name: Rayquaza
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: A Pokémon that flies endlessly in the ozone layer. It is said it would descend to the ground if Kyogre and Groudon were to fight.

resolved_author_values.Name: Deoxys
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: A Pokémon that mutated from an extraterrestrial virus exposed to a laser beam. Its body is configured for superior agility and speed.

resolved_author_values.Name: Burmy
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.

resolved_author_values.Name: Wormadam
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

resolved_author_values.Name: Wormadam
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon's body. The cloak is never shed.

resolved_author_values.Name: Cherrim
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It blooms during times of strong sunlight. It tries to make up for everything it endured as a bud.

resolved_author_values.Name: Shellos
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its colors and shapes differ from region to region. In the Sinnoh region, two types are confirmed.

resolved_author_values.Name: Gastrodon
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It has a pliable body without any bones. If any part of its body is torn off, it grows right back.

resolved_author_values.Name: Lopunny
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It swings its ears like whips and strikes its enemies with them. It has an intensely combative disposition.

resolved_author_values.Name: Garchomp
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its vaunted wings become scythes, sending it mad with rage. It swings its scythes wildly and slices the ground to pieces.

resolved_author_values.Name: Lucario
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It readies itself to face its enemies by focusing its mental energies. Its fighting style can be summed up in a single word: heartless.

resolved_author_values.Name: Abomasnow
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It whips up blizzards in mountains that are always buried in snow. It is the abominable snowman.

resolved_author_values.Name: Gallade
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: A master of courtesy and swordsmanship, it fights using extending swords on its elbows.

resolved_author_values.Name: Rotom
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This Rotom has possessed a convection microwave oven that uses a special motor. It also has a flair for manipulating flames.

resolved_author_values.Name: Rotom
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This form of Rotom enjoys coming up with water-based pranks. Be careful with it if you don't want your room flooded.

resolved_author_values.Name: Rotom
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Rotom assumes this form when it takes over a refrigerator powered by a special motor. It battles by spewing cold air.

resolved_author_values.Name: Rotom
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: In this form, Rotom applies its new power over wind to its love of pranks. It will happily blow away any important documents it can find.

resolved_author_values.Name: Rotom
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This is Rotom after it's seized control of a lawn mower that has a special motor. As it mows down grass, it scatters the clippings everywhere.

resolved_author_values.Name: Giratina
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.

resolved_author_values.Name: Shaymin
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.

resolved_author_values.Name: Arceus
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It is described in mythology as the Pokémon that shaped the universe with its 1,000 arms.

resolved_author_values.Name: Audino
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Its auditory sense is astounding. It has a radar-like ability to understand its surrounding through slight sounds.

resolved_author_values.Name: Basculin
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Even Basculin, which devours everything it can with its huge jaws, is nothing more than food to organisms stronger than itself.

resolved_author_values.Name: Darmanitan
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: When wounded, it stops moving. It goes as still as stone to meditate, sharpening its mind and spirit.

resolved_author_values.Name: Deerling
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon's fur. People use it to mark the seasons.

resolved_author_values.Name: Tornadus
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.

resolved_author_values.Name: Thundurus
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.

resolved_author_values.Name: Landorus
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.

resolved_author_values.Name: Kyurem
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It has foreseen that a world of truth will arrive for people and Pokémon. It strives to protect that future.

resolved_author_values.Name: Kyurem
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It's said that this Pokémon battles in order to protect the ideal world that will exist in the future for people and Pokémon.

resolved_author_values.Name: Kyurem
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: It generates a powerful, freezing energy inside itself, but its body became frozen when the energy leaked out.

resolved_author_values.Name: Keldeo
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: The power that lay hidden in its body now covers its horn, turning it into a sword that can slice through anything.

resolved_author_values.Name: Meloetta
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.

resolved_author_values.Name: Genesect
resolved_author_values.Pokedex: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.

resolved_author_values.Name: Greninja
